literal_meaning: কানাই (কৃষ্ণের শৈশব নাম) এবং বলাই (বলরামের শৈশব নাম)
figurative_meaning_bn: মুখ্য- কৃষ্ণ বলরাম; গৌণ- ভিন্ন হৃদয় বন্ধুদ্বয়
figurative_meaning_en: Primary: Krishna and Balaram; Secondary: Two friends with differing hearts/minds
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই ভাই কানাই-বলাইয়ের মতো ভিন্ন মতামত থাকলেও একসাথে থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: They are inseparable friends like Kanai and Balai.
The two brothers, like Kanai and Balai, have different opinions but stay together.
history: Refers to the childhood names of Krishna (Kanai) and his brother Balaram (Balai) in Bengali folklore and Vaishnava traditions, symbolizing their playful and contrasting yet united nature in Vrindavan tales.
note: Common in Bengali literature and oral traditions depicting divine sibling dynamics.
